src/store/lib/read.ts:
import { cached } from "./cache";
export function readShelf(): string { return cached(); }
src/store/lib/inner.ts:
import { hook } from "./hook";
export function inner(): void { hook(); }
src/report/report.ts:
import { auditShelf, SHELF_LIMIT, type ShelfType } from "../store";
export function report(shelf: ShelfType): string { auditShelf(); return shelf.name.slice(SHELF_LIMIT); }
infra/chart/templates/service.yaml:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: cart
spec:
  ports:
    - port: 80
infra/routes.yaml:
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: shop
spec:
  defaultBackend:
    service:
      name: cart
      port:
        number: 80
